response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are only those that appear in the telescopes table (observatories with zero telescopes are excluded from the count, total and average share).
The average share is taken over all observatories before filtering, and the summary averages are computed over only the observatories with share strictly above it.
